title: Buckeye Manufacturing Company, Columbia Avenue, Anderson, Madison County, IN
notes: Significance: Of the several automobile manufacturers established in Anderson, Indiana at the turn of the century, the Buckeye Manufacturing Company was the most successful.  Initially a manufacturer of buggy and harness equipment, under the influence of John W. Lambert's inventive genius, the company began to produce gasoline engines and automobiles.
